steps.en: Scaffold a new app with TypeScript and Tailwind in one command
steps.zh: 一条命令生成带 TypeScript 和 Tailwind 的新应用

steps.en: Add a route by creating a folder with a page file; fetch data right inside it
steps.zh: 建一个文件夹放一个 page 文件就是一条路由，数据直接在里面取

steps.en: Mark only the interactive pieces as client components
steps.zh: 只把需要交互的部分标成客户端组件

steps.en: Renders server components on the server, caches or streams the HTML to the browser
steps.zh: 在服务端渲染服务端组件，把 HTML 缓存或流式发给浏览器

steps.en: Bundles per route and ships JavaScript only for the client components
steps.zh: 按路由打包，只为客户端组件下发 JavaScript

steps.en: Build once and run it on any Node.js host, container or adapter platform
steps.zh: 构建一次，跑在任何 Node.js 主机、容器或适配平台上

value.en: One React codebase that serves fast, indexable HTML and its own backend endpoints — no separate API service or SSR plumbing to build
value.zh: 一套 React 代码同时产出能被搜索引擎收录的快速 HTML 和后端接口，不用另搭 API 服务

sources: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/01-installation.mdx (npx create-next-app@latest my-app --yes; default TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, App Router, Turbopack)
https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/05-server-and-client-components.mdx (Server Components by default; 'use client'; RSC Payload streamed)
https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/17-deploying.mdx (next build / next start; Node.js server, Docker, static export, adapters)
